title: Use Aveva API tote management to resend a tote task after an error/failed execution
summary: Use the Aveva API tote management page control “Resend Tote Task” to resend a command to a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute, then confirm the resend result in the API page output/response.
when_to_use: When a tote task has encountered an error or failed to execute and you need to resend the tote command using the Aveva API tote management page.
not_for: Do not use this procedure if you cannot identify which tote/task you intend to resend from the Aveva API tote management page (the source notes that you should confirm the tote/task context from the API before continuing).
Do not continue repeated resends without confirming the tote/task context from the API.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the “Resend Tote Task” action on the Aveva API tote management page and verify the API page response/confirmation for the resend request.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API page for tote management (“API Features for Tote Management”).
Ability to specify the tote/task to resend using the Aveva API tote management page controls.

access_required: Access to the Aveva API tote management page (“API Features for Tote Management”).
system_preconditions: The tote task you are addressing is visible/identifiable in the tote management API context (the page includes “Get Tote Task” to retrieve current tote task status).

visual_references.description: Aveva API tote management page (“API Features for Tote Management”) showing the “Resend Tote Task” control and related tote task functions (e.g., “Get Tote Task”).

steps.title: Open the Aveva API tote management page (“API Features for Tote Management”)
steps.purpose: Access the tote management API controls needed to resend a tote task.
steps.instruction: Open the Aveva API tote management page labeled “API Features for Tote Management” and navigate to the tote management controls that include “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.expected_result: The Aveva API tote management page is open and shows the “Resend Tote Task” function within the “API Features for Tote Management” controls.
steps.healthy_condition: The page displays the tote management feature list including “Get Tote Task” and “Resend Tote Task”.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load or the “Resend Tote Task” control is not visible.

actions.label: Verify tote management controls are visible
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Resend Tote Task” section/control on the “API Features for Tote Management” page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Aveva API tote management page does not load or “Resend Tote Task” is not visible, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Identify the tote/task to resend (tote with error/failed execution)
steps.purpose: Ensure the resend targets the correct tote/task that previously encountered an error or failed to execute.
steps.instruction: Using the tote management API page, identify the specific tote/task you intend to resend. The page includes “Get Tote Task” to retrieve the current tote task status; use that context to confirm the tote/task before resending.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the tote/task context to resend (i.e., the tote/task you are addressing is the one that encountered an error or failed to execute).
steps.healthy_condition: The tote/task you plan to resend is confirmed via the tote task status context available on the tote management API page (via “Get Tote Task”).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm which tote/task is being targeted for resend, or you are missing the tote/task context from the API.

actions.label: Retrieve current tote task context
actions.exact_action: Use the “Get Tote Task” function on the “API Features for Tote Management” page to retrieve the current tote task status.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm the tote/task context from the API, stop and escalate to support.
Do not continue repeated resends without confirming the tote/task context from the API.

steps.title: Execute “Resend Tote Task” for the identified tote/task
steps.purpose: Send the resend command to the tote for the previously failed/error tote task.
steps.instruction: On the Aveva API tote management page, use the “Resend Tote Task” function to resend the command for the tote/task you identified in the previous step.
steps.expected_result: A resend request is submitted via the “Resend Tote Task” function for the identified tote/task.
steps.healthy_condition: The resend action is triggered for the intended tote/task (the resend command is issued for a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute).
steps.failure_condition: The resend action cannot be executed (e.g., control/action is unavailable) or the API indicates an error for the resend request.

actions.label: Resend tote task command
actions.exact_action: Use the “Resend Tote Task” function on the “API Features for Tote Management” page to resend the command to the tote.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the API does not accept the resend or returns an error, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Confirm the resend was accepted via the API page response/output
steps.purpose: Verify that the resend request was accepted and processed by the API.
steps.instruction: Check the Aveva API tote management page response/output area for the resend action result/confirmation.
steps.expected_result: The API page shows a confirmation/accepted result for the resend action (or an error if it was not accepted).
steps.healthy_condition: The resend action produces a successful/accepted response in the API page output/response area.
steps.failure_condition: The API page returns an error or indicates the resend was not accepted.

actions.label: Review resend response/confirmation
actions.exact_action: Verify the resend action result in the API page response/output area.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the API returns an error or does not accept the resend, stop and escalate to support.

success_criteria: The “Resend Tote Task” command is issued for a tote that encountered an error or failed to execute.
The Aveva API tote management page response/output indicates the resend was accepted (no error returned for the resend request).
healthy_conditions: The tote management API page shows “Resend Tote Task” and “Get Tote Task” controls.
The resend action produces a successful/accepted response in the API page output/response area.
failure_conditions: The API does not accept the resend or returns an error.
The tote/task context cannot be confirmed from the API (risk of resending the wrong tote/task).
escalation_guidance: If the API does not accept the resend or returns an error, stop and escalate to support.
If you cannot confirm the tote/task context from the API, stop and escalate to support.
